about: Derived, not recorded as it stands: no empty resumed turn could be recorded from the sandbox this was written in (it cannot run a signed-in Claude Code). The events are those of the resumed attempt (attempt 2) of test/recordings/redrive-other-request.json, a real Claude Code 2.1.322 session resumed with --resume, with its tool call, permission request and answer, tool result and text taken out: what is left is how a resumed turn that ends with no reply and no change reads through the driver. The usage numbers are the recorded turn's, which did more than this one; nothing reads them here.
